discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 229051e. If the reader thread fails to start, the session is removed from the map and the shell is killed before the error is returned.

from agentic review: `clamp_window_bounds` panics on a zero-size work area: the `.max(1)` guard guarantees `clamp(min, max)` gets `min > max`, and the call site is in `setup`, so the app fails to launch rather than degrading.

Fixed. Empty or inverted work areas now return an error, so setup logs the fitting failure and still reveals the window instead of panicking. The arithmetic also uses `i64` internally to cover the full Win32 `i32` coordinate domain. Regression tests cover empty and extreme-coordinate work areas.
i tried it. taskbar icon persists as midnight no matter what i pick. tried restarting the app - still the default.
Hmm, that's weird, works for me...

Confirmed. Windows owns the pinned taskbar and task-group icon through the installed shortcut, so the runtime `WM_SETICON` override could not make this reliable across Windows configurations. I removed that unsupported path and its duplicate ICO resources. The picker now promises the supported Windows surface—the System tray—while the running window and Alt+Tab icon still update through Tauri.
